answer: You can still sell us the car and pay the difference at the appointment. We accept a cashier's check or a debit card, but not personal checks or credit cards. Lakeshore Bank is in our e-payoff network, so you don't need a payoff letter: we confirm the payoff with them electronically the same day, at your appointment, using your loan account number. If you'd rather not pay the difference, you can keep the car, since an offer never obliges you to sell.
